ruling.by: the wave's orchestrator, on the operator's campaign allocation
ruling.made_after_observing: the second attempt's stop on the unknown-cost rule: a world-edit draft ran to the 2048-token cap and its repair attempt timed out with a cost the execution record could not state
ruling.rule_before: any attempt whose cost_basis is unknown stops the run
ruling.rule_after: an attempt the record cannot price no longer stops the run; the request's cost is the spending ledger's charge across it, which holds that attempt at its reservation, and it counts toward the harness's ceiling; the attempt counts as a provider error under the 10 percent per-pass rule; a request with a server answer is scored on that answer, so a 502 model_refused after a truncated draft is a wrong answer, not an error
